rows: - Probe: `vm-ops-api` `GET /stats` (host meminfo/load + per-container working set and CPU%), surfaced as `wf vm ops stats`. First reading under load: 11.9 GB host, no swap, 973 MB available, load 17-18; `agent-shell-dind` 1.9 GB at 136-152% CPU, `gh-runner` 0.96 GB, `metro-runner` 0.94 GB idle, `android-emulator` 0.40 GB idle.
- Memory-for-CPU trade: rejected. Available RAM is about 1 GB and there is no swap, so there is nothing to spend on caches or tmpfs build dirs; the bottleneck is 2 OCPUs shared by builds.
